name: ALLVAS
group: Aopeng Medical with Shanghai Changhai Hospital (Qingsheng Lu) and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Kundong Wang) (song2022_biomimetic affiliations; company not named there)
versions: ALLVAS; predecessor: the group's first-generation robot ('similar to the first-generation surgical robot initially studied by our research group', song2022_biomimetic p. 14, refs 13-14 = Wang 2018 IJMRCAS 14:e1915 and Lu 2020 VES 54:598-604; not read) -> 2022 biomimetic system, 38 porcine cases (song2022_biomimetic; robot unnamed there, identified as ALLVAS by song2023_novel, which cites it) -> 2023 EVAR in patients (song2023_novel); 2022: Changhai (Q. Lu) remote-controlled robot driven by hollow ultrasonic motors, ex vivo phantom (Lu 2022) (Alekseeva 2025 Table 7 row 1, Fig. 13e; Belikov 2024 Fig. 6 QIN) (alekseeva2025_design; belikov2024_evolution)
devices_driven: four manipulators with double V-grippers handle devices from a 0.014-in (0.36 mm) guidewire to a 40 mm stent-graft system (song2022_biomimetic p. 5); 2-3 devices at once in the porcine cases (catheter + guidewire, or stent-graft system, inner core and guidewire in TEVAR) (p. 10); up to 4 devices (song2023_novel); compatible with market devices
n_dof_detail: 18 (slave: two three-axis arms and four manipulators, each manipulator with two DC motors and a stepper; song2022_biomimetic p. 4, 7); '12-DOF motion in the four directions of the short axis' (p. 14); 12 per mandhumula2025_robotic as REIS
rotation_detail: rotatable V-grippers, continuous progressive rotation with relay gripper (song2023_novel)
device_range: max axial speed 275 mm/s, min 5.15 mm/s, max thrust 27.45 N, max displacement 140 cm (song2022_biomimetic Table 1); rotation speeds 1.57 and 0.52 rad/s (p. 7)
force_sensing: force feedback; force sensor on the manipulator (type N.R.), in vitro feedback delay < 60 ms, peak error 0.15 N (song2022_biomimetic p. 8); automatic mode halts above 2 N (liang2025_unleashing)
haptics_leader: joysticks on a console outside the cath lab: button = clamp/release, knob = rotate, swing = advance/retract; force-feedback handle based on electromagnetic resistance (song2022_biomimetic p. 3, 7, 14; the paper says both 'four joysticks' and 'two sets of master joysticks')
sterility: detachable grippers, aimed at replacing all contact parts (song2022_biomimetic abstract, p. 14); single-use status N.R.
validation_detail: EVAR 5 pts (song2023_novel); 4 pts programmed steps (liang2025_unleashing); 1 remote PCI 800 km (Xu 2024); animal: 10 domestic swine (45 kg), 38 robotic cases (PCI 8, TEVAR 4, renal stent 8, iliac stent 10, IVC filter 8), 5 surgeons, plus a 3D-printed aorto-iliac model (song2022_biomimetic p. 9-12)
key_numbers: EVAR 5/5, operator dose -96.5% (song2023_novel abstract); remote PCI latency 30 ms, 800 km (chen2026_teleoperation Table I); swine: all technically successful, no adverse events, PCI operator dose 24.6 +- 2.72 uGy robotic vs 2224 +- 92.5 manual (the manual operator values equal the manual patient values in every column, possibly a table error), operative time not different, device exchange within 10 s, rotation accuracy 1 degree (song2022_biomimetic Table 2, p. 14)
sim_model: yes for vessels/wire: SOFA-based training platform of Tongji group (yao2025_sim4endor, full); no model of the robot itself found
sim2real_detail: YES: chen2026_learning (SAC + MPC filter, sim 49/50 -> phantom 18/20, full, IROS 2026); tian2026_visionlanguage (phantom 30/30, full); Tongji group lists 7 papers on ALLVAS/SOFA (S7b.md); liu2024_autonomous trained on robot not sim
